notes: The plaque durations cover answer interaction. Intra-museum movement is costed by the walk edges.
The Bone Voyage barge dialogue actions include their on-barge movement. The sailing action includes steering and the short move to the camp pier.
Round-trip, walk and ship ranges are initial planning estimates. Timed live runs and a connected mainland travel network are pending.

Each targeted relic search budgets two hours including mining, walking and crushing. This rough planning allowance assumes about 20 seconds per processed deposit across several hundred deposits. The six-hour high estimate is not a guarantee. Other relics can drop in the same session. Credit only the successful deposit’s XP and replan for incidental gains or finds. Curator dialogue is estimated at nine seconds per unique relic.
